notes: Hip-roofed two-storey house with bays at both ends of the south front and a hooded front door near the middle. Ground floor raised: small basement windows show just above grade on the south; ground-floor sills at ~7.2 ft, second-floor sills at ~16.6 ft, eaves ~21 ft. South: clear, both storeys; right end (0.9-1.0) has a side porch/steps, smeared. East: second storey is a band of six windows (sleeping-porch style), clear; ground storey left half (0-0.5) hidden by a smeared mesh blob, only two windows readable. North: the right half (0.45-1.0) is a hole in the mesh showing the south front from behind (the hooded door and windows are the south facade mirrored), so only the left half was read; openings on the right half of the north side are unknown. West: left part (0-0.5) clear with a triple window below and one window above; right part (0.6-1.0) is the oblique faces of the south-west bay, smeared, windows approximate. East storey 2's six windows are a continuous ribbon, given as two triple openings (0.12-0.48 and 0.62-0.97) because an interior wall meets the east wall at about 0.55. West triple window narrowed from ~93 to 78 in to clear an interior wall. North storey-2 window seen at ~0.31, given at 0.29 so it clears an interior wall. South door given at 0.447 (seen ~0.47) and the window left of it at 0.35 (seen ~0.37) so both fit the wall segment ending at the jog at 0.507.
